title: Chapter 389: The Destitute Moon Clan
content:
Chapter 389: The Destitute Moon Clan

The Moon Clan now has only this small piece of ancestral land, and nothing is left.

The boy was full of yearning for the outside world. He wanted to go out and try it out, but unfortunately, he didn't have that ability.

Therefore, he placed all this on this once glorious ancestor.

After all, as far as he knows, this ancestor is still alive and is the only one who lives.

Even if he has countless infamous reputations on his back, so what?

Only strength is the kingly way.

You run slowly and hear curses, but when you run very fast, you only hear the sound of the wind.

At the same time, there are countless scenery.

That is also the yearning in the boy's heart.

"Boy, what are you doing?!"

Just as the boy was fantasizing, a sudden scolding suddenly came from outside the temple.

Hearing this old voice, the boy was shocked and quickly got up.

Turning around and looking, an old man in a thick linen was walking towards him angrily, holding a wooden stick that he picked up from somewhere.

"Clan, patriarch, I,"

Seeing this old man, the young man couldn't help but feel a little scared, and his tone of speaking trembled.

Seeing this, it was obviously not the first time the boy had.

"Boy, it's you again. Today I have to hit you with a lame leg!"

As he said that, the old man raised the wooden stick in his hand high and waved it towards the boy.

For a moment, a tragic shout suddenly sounded in the temple.

But at this moment, the old man suddenly felt something and stopped with the movement in his hand.

Although the boy didn't know what was going on, he still felt awake and hurriedly ran out of the temple with all his strength.

A plop!

"Ouch!"

The boy seemed to have hit something very hard and sat down on the ground.

"What's the matter?"

The boy shook his head, opened his eyes and looked closely, and then he realized that at some point, two figures suddenly appeared at the entrance of the temple.

He just now hit one of them.

At this time, the old man behind the young man walked slowly towards the two of them with confusion.

"Who are you?"

The two of them were naturally Lu Daosheng and Yue Shi Shen who had just arrived.

Both of them saw everything that just happened.

Lu Daosheng still had that harmless smile, while Yue Shishen lowered his head slightly, as if he did not dare to face the old man and the young man in the temple.

"I have heard of the great name of the Moon Clan for a long time, so I'll visit you today."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and bowed to the old man, which was very polite.

But this sentence made the old man look a little cold, and he sneered and said, "Are you really a foreigner? Sorry, my Yue clan does not welcome foreigners. Where do the two of them come from and where can they go back."

After saying this, the old man pulled the young man past the two of them and left the small temple.

Lu Daosheng was stunned, looked at the indifferent Yue Shi Shen, and couldn't help but sigh slightly.

But the boy who was pulled by the old man was not very honest. He broke free from the old man and exclaimed, "Class leader, they are foreigners. Have you seen a few foreigners who can enter our Yue clan!"

As we all know, their ancestral land of the Moon Clan has powerful protection of laws.

It is difficult to enter if it is not their Yue tribe.

Unless they are extremely powerful, and those strong people don’t bother to attack the people of the Moon Clan.

This is also the reason why their Moon Clan is now weak and still can survive.

And now, two foreigners appeared in their Moon Clan, which made the young man who had always longed for the outside world see a glimmer of hope.

If I had the opportunity to follow these two people out, I would be excited to think about it.

But when facing the boy, the old man didn't care, "Don't worry about this little business and stay honestly."

As the current leader of the Yue clan, would he not know about this?

He naturally knew it, but so what.

Their Moon Clan can't stand any trouble now. In other words, their Moon Clan is now deposed.

It is God's mercy to be able to preserve this bloodline and survive.

But the boy didn't seem to want to give up, "Class leader, I,"

Bang!

The old man slapped the boy on the forehead.

The force is just right, and it's not a headache.

In this way, the young man was dragged toward the distance by the old man, and his figure went further and further.

At the entrance of the temple.

Lu Daosheng and the others watched them go away quietly.

"I really didn't expect that the glorious and prosperous Moon Clan now has only two hundred people left."

Lu Daosheng sighed in his voice.

Yue Shi God was still silent.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said again: "Didn't you find that the young man's talent is not bad? If you train it well, you may not have achieved anything in the future."

Yue Shi Shen lowered his head slightly, and he thought of his youth.

At that time, he was also pretentious.

That boy looked like when he was young.

If he received him, would he become the same as himself?

Seeing that the Yue Shi God fell into deep thought, Lu Daosheng said, "Why go to the Yue Clan and see how they live now."

Hearing this, Yue Shi Shen stopped silent and nodded, "Okay."

In this way, the two followed the direction of the old man and the young man leaving.

The ancestral land of the Moon Clan is like a small island isolated from the world.

In the middle of the island stands a village.

The entire village is made of an ore called moonstone. Every time it is moonlit night, the village will emit soft moonlight.

It was early morning now.

The first ray of sunlight shone on the village and casted light on the moonstone, giving people a very warm feeling.

Lu Daosheng and the others walked slowly from afar and were soon discovered by several Yue tribe members guarding the entrance of the village.

When they saw the two, the people of the Moon Clan seemed to have seen something terrifying. They were stunned for a moment and hurried into the village.

For a moment, the whole village seemed to be in panic.

"It seems that we are not very popular."

Lu Daosheng smiled and said to himself.

Soon, the two of them walked into the village.

The village was silent and every family was closed.

The two walked for a long time before they could barely see a figure.

It was that boy.

At this time, the boy was standing in the distance, showing a smile to the two of them.

Seeing the boy, Lu Daosheng said in a little puzzled manner: "The villagers are so scared when they see us, why aren't you afraid of us?"

The young man smiled and said, "With the skills of the two seniors, if you want to do something bad, I'm afraid no one in the whole village can stop you. But now, the village is still good, and I'm fine, so I believe that the two seniors must not be. Bad guy.”

Lu Daosheng nodded. This young man was smart.

Then Lu Daosheng unconsciously glanced at the Yue Shi God beside him.
